question: How is net realized revenue defined in the current version?

input.answer_text: net_realized_revenue = settled_revenue − total_refunds. It is a derived, scalar-only metric, so it has no dimensional cuts. settled_revenue is SUM(amount) over payments with status = 'settled'. total_refunds is SUM(refund_amount) over all refund rows, with partial refunds respected. Note that net_realized_revenue has no change log of its own. However, total_refunds changed in v3 (2026-10-09). Refunds are now attributed to the month of the original payment (payment_date), where v1 and v2 used the refund event month (refund_date). This was done so refunds match the revenue period they offset. As a result, monthly figures for the refund component differ from the older attribution.
